paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 2.61 as of October 30, representing a decline of 8.74% from the prior close and 38% over a window of 23 sessions. There have been no new news headlines in the last 24 hours.

Recent news headlines include a report from MarketBeat on October 28 stating that Fermi shares were up 15.3%, and a news item from Yahoo Finance Singapore also on October 28 providing information on the company's stock price and history.

Insider filings include a Form 4 filed on October 22 and another on October 15, both reporting transactions by officers, directors, or 10% holders, as well as Form 144 filings on October 20 and October 14, indicating intentions to sell restricted shares. Additionally, an 8-K filing on October 16 announced an amendment to the Equipment Supply Loan Financing Agreement with MUFG Bank, Ltd.
